curios.text:
multiple curios - notes only

The first 3 turns of all encounters, draw +1books - you can't select your summoned books any longer.
Gain 1 Cursed Book and 2 Rare summons. (cursed books are new - they are books that start in your Deck and you cant remove them by Merchants)
Remove a non-Cursed book from your Library
Whenever you lose a Visitor, all other Visitors gain 2 fulfillment
Whenever you play a Book from hand, draw 1 book. Shuffle 3 Cursed Books into your Library.
